name: floor_share
unit: share of roof footprint that is floor

name: birds_per_ft2
unit: birds per ft2 of floor at placement
source: NCC Animal Welfare Guidelines (6.5-9 lb/ft2 at market weight); DCA 2024 average live weight 7.3 lb

name: flocks_per_year
source: Delmarva practice; DCA 2024 (601 M birds / 4909 houses = 122k birds per house per year)

name: active_share
unit: share of mapped houses holding birds
source: Extension: rusted roofs are not a reliable idle sign; MDE permits cover 66% of mapped capacity (Task 1 notebook 12)
note: to refine with the MDE active/idle cross-check

name: litter_lb_per_bird
unit: lb of litter (as removed) per bird marketed
source: UD Extension (Pokhrel & Shober 2024) 2.3-3 lb/bird; DLLC 2019 / Chesapeake Bay Program 1.5 t per 1000 birds per year; new Delmarva study (DCA 2026) ~25% below the Bay model rate

name: N_lb_per_ton
unit: lb total N per wet ton of litter
source: DLLC 2019 citing CBP Poultry Litter Subcommittee 2015 (DE/MD lab records); UGA B1245 (Georgia) 64 lb as high end

name: P_lb_per_ton
unit: lb P (elemental) per wet ton of litter
source: DLLC 2019 citing CBP 2015 (DE/MD); litter P fell ~16% 1995-2013 (phytase)

name: N_available
unit: share of litter N available to the crop in year 1 (after losses)
source: Tewolde et al. 2013 (31%); Kansas State 45-55%; Oklahoma State 50-60%; DLLC 2019 20% ammonia loss
note: Maryland Nutrient Management Manual value pending (Rafi)

name: corn_N_lb_per_acre
unit: lb N per acre (UMD recommendation by yield goal)
source: UMD yield-goal recommendation ~1 lb N per bushel; Eastern Shore yield goals 140-190 bu/ac
note: Rafi: MD manual rate and yield goals

name: corn_P2O5_lb_per_acre
source: ~0.37 lb P2O5 per bushel x 140-190 bu/ac

name: soy_P2O5_lb_per_acre
unit: lb P2O5 per acre (crop removal; soybeans take no N)
source: ~0.8 lb P2O5 per bushel x 40-60 bu/ac

name: small_grain_P2O5_lb_per_acre
source: ~0.5 lb P2O5 per bushel x 60-80 bu/ac
note: DLLC: wheat/barley P rate was one of three contested points

name: P_rate_multiplier
unit: P applied on soils below the high-P threshold / crop removal
source: DLLC 2019: optimum (= removal) vs medium (build-up) category was not agreed (>6000 t difference)

name: high_P_offset
unit: added to the share of cropland too high in P to take any (from the DLLC fit)
source: DLLC 2019 Maryland fit: % cropland above FIV 150 = 1.632 x (lb litter P per cropland acre) + 10.294 (R2 0.89)

name: hay_N_lb_per_acre
unit: lb N per acre (grass hay; used only when hay is included)

name: hay_P2O5_lb_per_acre
unit: lb P2O5 per acre (removal; used only when hay is included)
source: ~12 lb P2O5 per ton of hay x 2-4 t/ac
